notes: Excluded: Mumbai Suburban Railway (Western/Central/Harbour/Trans-Harbour) and the BKC pod taxi, by request.
Segment station lists include both endpoints, so adjacent segments share a station; n_stations = len(stations) except where list is empty (then official count).
Operational as of 2026-10 (Wikipedia network table): L1, 2A, 2B (Mandale–Chembur, 6 stns), 3, 7, 9 (Dahisar E–Kashigaon) = 79 stations / 91.48 km. Monorail is built but suspended since 2025-09-20.
Opening dates: Line 3 inaugurated 5 Oct 2024/public 7 Oct; phases 9/10 May 2025 and 8/9 Oct 2025. Line 2B/9 inaugurated 7 Apr 2026, public 8 Apr. Months are unaffected.
Line 4/4A: no source confirms opening by mid-Oct 2026 (latest Sep 2026: trials, CMRS rolling-stock clearance 28 Aug). Re-check before publishing; could open around Diwali/Nov 2026.

Line 2B naming conflict: news names Phase-1 stations 'Diamond Garden, Shivaji Chowk, BSNL Metro, Mankhurd, Mandale'; Wikipedia uses 'Deshbhakt N.G. Acharya Udyan-Diamond Garden, Chembur', 'Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Chowk (Chembur)', 'Deonar' (= BSNL Metro, inferred), 'Maharashtranagar Mandale'. First 2B station after Andheri (W) was ESIC Nagar in tender docs; Wikipedia now 'Hare Ram Hare Krishna Mandir - Juhu' (likely renamed, unverified). Old Airport/National College/MMRDA/Kurla Terminus stations dropped.
Line 2B station count: planned 20–22 vs 19 new stations in Wikipedia list; 2B length 23.643 km.
Line 9: Amar Palace/Jhankar Company were earlier names (inferred: now Miragaon/Kashigaon). Phase 2 target conflicts: Dec 2026 (station table, CM) vs Dec 2027 (Wikipedia summary).
Line 7A target conflicts: Dec 2026 vs Dec 2027 on Wikipedia; no official date.
Line 4 count: Wikipedia main-line table 38 stations incl. Line 10 (4) and 4A (2); Line 4 proper = 32 stations, 32.32 km.

Line 5: Wikipedia phase table says 23.53 km for Kapurbawdi–Dhamankar Naka, which conflicts with 12.811 km package CA-28 and 11.9 km in Aug 2026 approval; used 12.811. Approval says 6 stations on Thane–Bhiwandi vs 7 in CA-28 list. Bhiwandi–Kalyan list predates realignment.
Line 12: Wikipedia lists Kalyan Railway Station to Amandoot (19 stns); originally Kalyan APMC–Taloja, 20.75 km, 17 stations. Kalyan Railway Station sits between Line 5 and 12 in the table.
Line 10: approval says 5 stations; Wikipedia lists 4 new stations + Gaimukh. Length 9.2/9.676/9.718 km in different sources.

Line 11: earlier 16-station alignment (with Reay Road, Crawford Market, Coal Bunder, SPM Circle) superseded; terminus sometimes given as Regal Cinema. Dharavi/Bandra Terminus extension is proposal-stage.
Line 8: station list is Wikipedia's; consistent with cabinet note of 6 UG stations CSMIA T2→Ghatkopar(E). A blog list (Marol Naka, Powai, Kanjurmarg, Airoli…) contradicts it and is not used.
Line 13: 16 stations per Aug 2026 approval (one post says 17 in revised DPR); names not officially published, left empty. Wikipedia main page still shows old 23 km/Rs 6,900 cr.
Line 14: proposed; length 38–45 km in sources; no official station list.

Navi Mumbai: Line 1 has no official colour in sources (color null). Lines 2–4 per CIDCO 2023 MetroNeo decision; an older 106 km masterplan (Vashi/Turbhe/Ghansoli lines) is outdated and omitted. Line 1A only on Wikipedia.
Monorail: Wikipedia infobox says 18 stations, station table lists 17; length 19.54 vs 20.21 km.
Colours: Mumbai Metro hexes from Wikipedia Module:Adjacent stations/Mumbai Metro (official line names Blue/Yellow/Aqua/Green/Orange/Pink/Red/Gold/Purple/Magenta). Line 11 has no assigned colour.
Not included (no current evidence): Monorail Phase I/II lines 2–8 (shelved), Line 9 extension to Uttan, MMRDA '10 new corridors' report (undated).
